user.description: Log in with your my.ekz.ch account. The login is stored in Home Assistant and used to fetch your consumption.

data_description.installation_id: The installationId used in the my.ekz.ch consumption API (visible in the browser's network tab).

backfill.name: Backfill
backfill.description: Re-import the last number of days of consumption from my.ekz.ch.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days back from yesterday to import (1-366).

archive.title: Archive raw data
archive.description: Optionally keep the raw responses from my.ekz.ch (15 minute and daily JSON). Statistics are imported either way.

drive.title: Google Drive
drive.description: Share a Drive folder with the service account's e-mail address (Editor), then paste its JSON key and the folder ID.

tariffs.title: Tariffs
tariffs.description:
One entry per period, with an inclusive date range and the peak and off-peak rate in CHF/kWh. Days not covered by any period are skipped and reported under Repairs. Clear the field to go back to the built-in tariffs. Changed tariffs apply to newly imported days; run the asyncenergy.backfill action to recalculate older ones.

{error}

error.invalid_service_account: Not a valid service account JSON key
error.invalid_tariffs: Invalid tariffs, see the message above

missing_tariff.title: No tariff for some days
missing_tariff.description: {count} day(s) between {first_day} and {last_day} for {title} were not imported because no tariff period covers them. Add the missing period under Configure > Tariffs, then run the asyncenergy.backfill action to import those days.
